description: For a finite nonempty structure \(M\), its specified fragment \(\Gamma_M\), consisting of the named covering sentence and every inequality \(d\ne c_a\), is a subset of the proper-extension theory of \(M\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Diagrams.exactFiniteObstruction_subset.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] [Finite M] [Nonempty M] :
  ↑(Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Diagrams.exactFiniteObstruction L M) ⊆
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Diagrams.properExtensionTheory L M
